title: Python for DevOps Engineers
overview: This course is designed to teach DevOps engineers how to leverage Python for automation, infrastructure management, CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and cloud operations. The course covers key DevOps tools and frameworks such as Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible, Terraform, Jenkins, AWS, and Azure, along with Python scripting to automate and optimize DevOps workflows.
audience: Software Engineers & IT Professionals involved in infrastructure management
Automation Engineers looking to streamline workflows
methodology: Hands-on Practice – Real-world automation scripts and cloud operations
Live Demonstrations – Python scripting for DevOps tools
Case Studies & Best Practices – Industry applications of Python in DevOps
Collaborative Learning – Peer reviews and real-world DevOps challenges
Capstone Project – Building an automated DevOps pipeline
competencies: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Python & Terraform
Configuring and Deploying Applications using Python & Ansible
CI/CD Pipeline Automation using Python & Jenkins
Cloud Automation using Python with AWS, Azure, and GCP
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Write Python scripts for DevOps automation
Manage cloud infrastructure using Python SDKs (Boto3, Azure SDK)
Use Python for configuration management with Ansible
Deploy and manage Docker containers & Kubernetes clusters using Python
Automate CI/CD pipelines using Python & Jenkins
Monitor and log system events using Python

outline.title: Module 1: Introduction to Python for DevOps

items.text: Python Basics (Data Types, Loops, Functions, OOP)
Working with APIs & HTTP Requests (Requests Library)
Introduction to Scripting for DevOps Tasks
Automating System Administration (SSH, File Handling, Logging)
Writing Python Scripts for Building & Managing Docker Containers
Automating Container Orchestration with Docker SDK
Managing Kubernetes Clusters using Python & Kubectl
Automating Kubernetes Deployments with Python SDK

outline.title: Module 6: CI/CD Pipeline Automation with Python

items.text: Introduction to Continuous Integration & Continuous Deployment
Using Python with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD

outline.title: Module 7: Cloud Automation with Python (AWS, Azure, GCP)

items.text: Using Python SDKs: Boto3 (AWS), Azure SDK, Google Cloud SDK
Automating EC2, S3, Lambda Functions with Python
Using Python for System Monitoring & Log Analysis
Integrating Python with ELK Stack & Prometheus

outline.title: Module 9: Security & Compliance Automation with Python
